Getting started
with BALAN.

A quick look at the bot and its modules. Detailed command instructions will be added once the configuration is verified.

Invite the bot

Use the invite button on the BALAN page once it becomes available. A server administrator must approve the requested permissions in Discord.

What BALAN is designed to do

Moderation, security, tickets, temporary voice channels, levels, giveaways, self roles and logging. Which modules are available and their commands depend on the deployed bot version.

Before you enable a module

Review the bot permissions, choose the channels and roles it needs, and consult the BALAN privacy policy and terms. Documentation for each module will follow the verified release.
